name: Far Beyond The World: Reverse World
source:
Azazel - You couldn't defeat him?
Azazel - It's good that the central god spared you.
Azazel - I hope this punishment won't be too harsh.
Azazel - It's too early for you to die Caelan.
Azazel - You must defeat him.

It tells the story of what happened to Caelan from [url=/v35324]Humans Last Hope[/url] after the first battle with Omega.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250803055037/https://rui314.itch.io/far-beyond-the-world-reverse-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿撒兹勒——你没能击败他吗？
阿撒兹勒——中央之神饶了你一命，已是不幸中的万幸。
阿撒兹勒——但愿这次降下的惩罚不会太过严苛。
阿撒兹勒——凯兰，你还不到丧命于此的时候。
阿撒兹勒——你必须击败他。

本作讲述了《[url=/v35324]Humans Last Hope[/url]》中的凯兰在与欧米伽初次交锋之后的遭遇。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250803055037/https://rui314.itch.io/far-beyond-the-world-reverse-world]Itch.io[/url]]
